discovery_notes: Top-up to packet 78 (84 pins not repeated). 25 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet. Princess 2022 and Disney100 Dec 2022 lead-up filled well, mostly DPB. Most new pins are Disney Parks-wide (DL+WDW) per source. Galaxy's Edge, Toontown, World of Color One, Pixar Pier, DTD/hotel searches found only LE/LR or post-2022 items. Reopening 2021: Magic is Back is LR; April 2021 family pins added. Extra Magic Minutes also lists a Mickey & Pluto Disney100 pin, date unclear, not recorded.
